PRODUCT DESCRIPTION  The product in process is from the Vitis vinifera L. family formed of sun dried seedless sultanas. After being double washed, sultanas are aspirated then sieved and also handpicked selected online. PACKAGING  The cardboard should be clean and strong.  The polyethylene bag shouldn't be dirty and torn.  The products are packed in cardboard boxes with inner polyethylene plastic bag, transparent or blue in color.  Bulk packaging of 5 - 10 - 12,5 - 14 Kgs / net in cartons. Plastic case of 15 Kgs / net.  Cellobags of min. 200 g / net and max. 1 Kg / net. Blank cellobags of 3 Kgs and 5 Kgs net each.  Cartons are clearly marked according to Turkish Std. Regulation (TS 3411) and buyer's requirements.  The cartons are sealed with tape and than are passed through a metal detector.
